# Riftstalker

Most rangers learn forests. Riftstalkers learn the Rift. They know how the Veil warps geography, which pools riftbeasts drink from, what the violet-black energy means when it crackles in a particular direction. They don't track footprints — they track the Rift's resonance.

A Riftstalker can walk into a Rift-touched forest and read it like a map. They know where the riftwolves den, when the riftbear last passed through, and whether that phase-step glow means a hunter or a pack leader. They hunt things that shouldn't exist — and they're very good at it.

## Rift Sense

*3rd-level Riftstalker feature*

You can attune to the Rift's frequency to read what moves through it. By spending 1 minute in concentration while in a Rift-touched area, you can sense recent riftbeast activity within 1 mile. You learn the approximate direction, the creature's general size (small, medium, large, huge), and how recently it passed (within an hour, within a day, within a week).

Additionally, you automatically detect the presence and location of Rift pools within 60 feet. You feel their pull — the Rift pools are always calling to you.

## Phase Tracker

*7th-level Riftstalker feature*

You've learned to read a phase-step before it completes. When a riftbeast or Rift-touched creature within 60 feet uses a phase-step, teleport, or similar instantaneous movement ability, you can use your reaction to glimpse its destination just before it arrives. You can immediately move up to your speed toward that point.

You follow them through the Veil — or at least, you're waiting when they land.

## Riftblade

*11th-level Riftstalker feature*

You know exactly where their Rift-hardened hides are weakest. Your weapon attacks against riftbeasts and Rift-touched creatures score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Years of hunting the Rift's children have taught you where the corruption meets the flesh — and where to strike.

## Elder Hunter

*15th-level Riftstalker feature*

The Rift remembers what you've done to its children — and they remember too. Riftbeasts and Rift-touched creatures within 30 feet of you have disadvantage on their first attack roll each combat against you. They hesitate. They flinch. They know what you are.
